text: You're looking for a satisfying and relatively light meal to fit within your 45-minute time frame and calorie goals. The Macaroni & Tomatoes recipe checks all those boxes. With a balance of creamy from the butter and parmesan cheese, and a good dose of carbs from the macaroni, this dish should hit the spot. Plus, it's ready in just 20 minutes, making it a great option for a quick and easy meal. At 184 calories per serving, it's also a relatively guilt-free choice.
